<thought>Search for a template that breaks an aldehyde and forms a C‑C double bond together with a carboxylic acid (the generic “carboxylic acid” functional group is available in the catalog). This should retrieve a Doebner‑type condensation template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds", "carboxylic acid"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
